site_name: Where’s My Cert? Find the distrusted eMudhra certificates | Spice Labs
site_description: Find the distrusted eMudhra and emSign certificates in your VM disk images, firmware and container images. Surveyor builds a CBOM of each, with no source code.

video.name: Where’s my cert? Surveyor OT Pro finds the distrusted eMudhra certificates
video.description: Surveyor OT Pro reads three VM disk images on a machine with no network, builds a CBOM of each, and finds the distrusted emSign root and two of the banned eMudhra intermediates by their SHA-256 fingerprints. It needs no source code.
